sam: quick q — where do I find the canonical mapping of PagerDuty services -> Slack channels? I need to confirm which channel gets page escalations for the inference runtime alerts (high latency / OOM).
nikita: it's in the runbook repo but the easier one is the internal doc: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/pagerduty-routing — look for 'inference-runtime' service. channels and escalation policies listed there. :point_up:
jordan: to add — the PD service name is `inference-runtime-prod`, escalation policy `Inference-Prod-Escalation`. Slack channel mapped is `#eng-oncall-inference` for pages, but we also mirror to `#eng-runtime-alerts` for lower-severity notifs.
sam: thanks — do we also forward PD incidents to the channel or only page notifications? trying to figure out noise vs real pages.
nikita: we forward both, but PD-level severity decides whether it's a page. The channel shows incidents with status changes. If you want to suppress incident messages (not pages), we can adjust the PD <-> Slack integration settings.
ops-sre: FYI, current setup: PD -> Slack duties are controlled by the 'Slack Alerts' extension on the `Inference-Prod-Escalation` policy. If you want to reduce noise, we recommend changing the PD event rules (example):
```
# PD rule (pseudo) to only notify Slack on high urgency
if incident.urgency == "high":
  notify.slack(channel="#eng-oncall-inference")
else:
  post.slack(channel="#eng-runtime-alerts")
```
Also recommend a 5m dedup window for repetitive latency spikes (our current is 1m).
jordan: +1 on increasing dedup window to 5m. For the latency alert specifically (`inference_high_90th_latency`) we can also bump the threshold from 750ms -> 850ms for the rolling 5m if noise comes from ephemeral GC on smaller instances. Would prefer to adjust after a short evaluation window.
oncall-rotation: pdkick: reminder that changing escalation windows needs a change ticket and ops-sre approval; I can schedule a quick review tomorrow 10:00am PT.
sam: ok — i'll open a brief RFC with the proposal (dedup->5m, latency->850ms for 24h eval) and link the runbook + dashboards. Can someone paste the dashboard link (latency hist + alert eval)?
nikita: here: https://console.redwood.ai/observability/dashboards/inference-latency (look at panel 'p50/p90/p99 by model and region'). Also use this query in metrics explorer: `rate(inference_latency_ms{env="prod"}[5m])` but better to check p90 aggregation.
pagerduty-bot: Integration test: slack-webhook for `Inference-Prod-Escalation` succeeded at 2026-03-17T14:02:17Z :white_check_mark:
sam: perfect — i'll draft the RFC and tag ops-sre + oncall-rotation. thanks all :heart:
